title: Beat catalog — the authored arc as project data
description: The arc store (2026-08-31 arc pass): BEATS are content-free rhetorical/pedagogical moves — welcomes, closures, persuade glosses, transitions — keyed by PLACEMENT, not by atom. A beat carries no copy: its words live in the register's voice pack under the beat_id (voice.pack.schema `beats` section), proposed by Dragoman voice mode and gated by the INVERSE guard (claim-free proven — a sentence that claims nothing can't lie). Twin stakes sentence: let words with no meaning anchor exist, while proving they carry none. A beat's `beat_hash` (sha256 of the canonical {beat_id, placement, intent}) is what beat copy pins as its source_hash — placement or intent moves, copy goes stale. Dramaturge (the arc facet owner) PROPOSES beats (status proposed); the designer ratifies by flipping status to accepted in this catalog — authored project data, like scenes.json. Never mint pseudo-atoms for rhetorical moves.

pedagogical.description: A governed id from intent.enum.json pedagogical values (e.g. hook, transfer). The validator enforces membership.

rhetorical.description: A governed id from intent.enum.json rhetorical values (e.g. persuade, transition).

from.description: Rationale — which wake fired, or the designer's reasoning. Never learner-facing.

proposed_by.description: e.g. dramaturge.v0.1/missing_arc_frame — provenance of the proposal.
